subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Power of Silence
description: Learn The Power of Silence in one minute.

hook.text: He stated his salary target and then kept talking nervously. By the end, he had negotiated himself down.

buildup.text: In negotiation, the person who speaks first after a number is named often concedes. Silence is uncomfortable.

discovery.text: State your request clearly, then stop talking. Let the silence work. The other party will fill it.

twist.text: Silence feels like hours to the speaker but only seconds to the listener. Your discomfort is amplified internally.

climax.text: Practice by counting to five silently after any ask. It gets easier. The pause projects confidence and conviction.

punchline.text: State your ask. Then stop. Silence is your ally.

quiz.question: Why is silence a powerful tool in negotiation?
options: It makes the other person uncomfortable and they leave
The other party often fills the silence with concessions
Silence is required by professional negotiation rules
